item.title: How Food Manufacturers Can Prevent Conveyor Carryback
item.description: Conveyor carryback is a serious issue in food processing facilities that can disrupt operations if not managed. Many facilities lack effective strategies to handle carryback, risking unscheduled downtime. Operators should implement preventative maintenance measures to minimize its impact.

item.title: VIDEO | Food Plant Openings and Expansions February 2026
item.description: EIC Alyse Thompson-Richards recaps some recent plant openings and expansions in the food and beverage industry, including Little Sesame’s new plant, InnovAsian’s frozen food facility, Charcuterie Artisans’ innovation center, BRIDOR’s expansion, M2 Ingredients’ innovation center and Boh Bah’s production facility.

item.title: Dainty Foods to Open Ohio Manufacturing Facility
item.description: The 250,000-square-foot facility will expand the company's production of rice and ready-to-heat meals in North America.

item.title: DrinkPAK Opens Beverage Manufacturing Facility in Texas
item.description: Completed by ARCO National Construction, the facility supports DrinkPAK’s expansion into North Texas and reflects a growing industry trend toward flexible, high-capacity contract beverage manufacturing.

item.title: Nestlé Purina Opens $481M Pet Food Facility in Brazil
item.description: The Vargeão site is Purina's largest investment in Brazil and will nearly double the company's wet pet food capacity in the country when fully operational.

item.title: How Coriolis Meters Helped Milk Processor Galloway Company Reduce Giveaway and Improve Efficiency
item.description: Galloway Company turned to Emerson for Coriolis meters to optimize its dairy processing operations by delivering precise and dependable flow measurements.

item.title: Bunge Acquires Lecithin, Soy Protein Concentrate and Crush Businesses from IFF
item.description: The acquired businesses include IFF's Response, Alpha, Procon and Solec brands. This transaction does not include IFF’s soy isolates business.

item.title: The Campbell’s Company Promotes Cassandra Green to Chief Supply Chain Officer
item.description: In this role, Green will continue to lead Campbell’s end-to-end supply chain, including customer logistics and planning, procurement, operational excellence, manufacturing and supply chain category leadership. She will also assume responsibility for food safety and quality.

item.title: CRB Co-Founder Jeff Biskup Assumes Emeritus Role on Company’s Board
item.description: Biskup will continue representing CRB across the industry – meeting with clients, attending key conferences and supporting collaboration and knowledge-sharing efforts across life sciences and food and beverage manufacturing.

item.title: Royal Cup Coffee to Acquire Farmer Brothers Coffee Co.
item.description: The agreement brings together two established coffee and tea organizations, representing nearly 250 years of combined industry experience.
